title: My Nephew Stole My $99K Birdhouse Company And Left Me $3.6K. So I Voided His $510K Sale
description: My nephew forged a dissolution and sold the birdhouse company I co-founded with my $99K inheritance, leaving me a $3,600 starter kit. I found the original notarized partnership agreement nailed under a feeder I built, voided the $510K sale, and now he works for me wearing a 'Nest of Lies' vest while every birdhouse links to his conviction. #FamilyBetrayal #InheritanceTheft #WingOfDeceit
thumb_text: HIDDEN NOTARIZED DEAL VOIDED HIS $510K SALE
